formulas.ascii: W = sum over regions r of sum over rows i in r of |x_i - mean_r|^2; T = sum over labelled rows of |x_i - mean|^2; B = T - W; pseudo-F = (B / (k - 1)) / (W / (n - k)), the Calinski-Harabasz score, with k non-empty regions and n labelled rows. Labels at or above labelCapacity and 0xffffffff are ignored. F is 1 when W = 0 and NaN when k < 2 or n <= k. Larger F means better separated regions of the same table.
